verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a Mail Send API, SMTP relay, sandbox validation, dynamic templates, and outbound Event and Inbound Parse webhooks. None of these is a product-native automation feature that runs autonomously in the background. Webhooks and the API are developer building blocks a user could use to build automations elsewhere, and the only Marketing Campaigns mention is a page title with no automation content.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
